turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Can you hear me okay?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Clearer if you face me and talk slowly.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Tell me what brought you in today.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: My chest has been troubling me.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Does it travel to your neck or shoulder?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, it stays right where it is.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: When did this start?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: It began yesterday afternoon.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Can you describe the pain for me?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: It is a tight squeezing feeling in the middle.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: What have you done to get relief?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I have not taken anything for it.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Does walking or climbing stairs bring it on?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, it comes even when I am sitting.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Do you have trouble breathing with it?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Yes, I feel winded.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Any dizziness or lightheadedness?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, I have not fainted.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Do you get sweaty or clammy when it happens?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, I do not sweat.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Tell me about your health conditions, like smoking, blood pressure, sugar and cholesterol.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I have high blood pressure. I have never smoked.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Does heart disease run in your family?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, not that I know of.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Have you ever had a heart procedure, like a stent or bypass surgery?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I had open heart surgery, a bypass.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Can you tell me your daily medicines?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I take Lisinopril.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Before we finish, let me go over the plan. First, come back to this clinic in one week. Second, see the heart specialist within two weeks. Third, take one baby aspirin every morning. Can you tell me back what the plan is, so I know I was clear?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I will come back here in a week, see the heart specialist in two weeks and take one baby aspirin each morning.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Is there anything else you want to ask me?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, I think I understand.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Thank you for coming in. Take care.
